newsitem.title: FRANCE: SGS-Thomson up nearly 10 pct on profit.
newsitem.headline: SGS-Thomson up nearly 10 pct on profit.

text.p: Shares in semiconductor maker SGS-Thomson Microelectronics NV jumped by nearly 10 percent after it reported a seven percent increase in third quarter earnings.
The share was up 9.9 percent at 288.10 francs at 1434 GMT.
Merrill Lynch said, prior to a conference call with management, that it expected to raise its 1996 estimate from $4.22 per share to $4.40.
SGS-Thomson chairman and chief executive Pasquale Pistorio said that despite difficult market conditions the company still had reasonable gross margins.
